Container.Name: VidCleaner
Container.Overview: Mutes profanity in the audio of movies and TV episodes managed by Sonarr/Radarr and played through Jellyfin. Adds a "Clean" audio track as the new default and keeps the original track and an untouched backup of the source file, so every change is reversible.
Container.Description: Mutes profanity in the audio of movies and TV episodes managed by Sonarr/Radarr and played through Jellyfin. Local CPU speech-to-text locates the words; ffmpeg mutes them.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings, logs and downloaded STT models

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your library. MUST be the same path Sonarr/Radarr/Jellyfin use.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Original files kept until purged. Keep it on the media share so swaps are same-filesystem renames.

Config.Name: Work
Config.Description: Scratch space for in-progress jobs. Put this on an SSD/cache pool.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the media share

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the media share

Config.Name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
Config.Description: Threads for speech-to-text. Roughly CPU cores minus 2.

Config.Name: Role
Config.Description: all | api | worker — split only for multi-host setups
